name: Monash University
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement as such; entry is by your secondary qualification against course minimums. English Level A (most courses): IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in every band, or an equivalent approved test. Medicine (direct entry) also requires the UCAT ANZ (or ISAT for international applicants) and an interview.
gpa_note: Course-specific minimum scores for your qualification; Medicine, Pharmacy and Law are the most competitive.

name: University of Toronto
tests: SAT/ACT not required for most curricula (used for some US-curriculum applicants). English: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 6.0), TOEFL iBT 100 (old scale, writing 22), Duolingo 120 – unless exempt.

name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
tests: SAT, ACT and AP are accepted with US-curriculum diplomas. English proof required: IELTS Academic, TOEFL, Duolingo, PTE and others are accepted (minimums shown per test on the International Qualifications page). Application fee HK$600.

name: PSL University (Université Paris Sciences & Lettres)
tests: No SAT/ACT. Most undergraduate programmes (e.g. CPES, Dauphine licences) are taught in French and require about B2–C1 French; a few English-taught tracks need IELTS 6.5–7.0 or equivalent.

name: University of Edinburgh
tests: No SAT/ACT (US applicants can use SAT/AP); UCAT for medicine. English: typically IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each part (higher for some programmes), or TOEFL iBT 92 (20 in each).

name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU)
tests: CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) with Mathematics is required; SAT (code 6563) or ACT (6983), A-level (Maths A) or IB (Maths HL 5) support the application. 2026 admits' middle 50%: SAT 1390-1500, ACT 30-34. English: TOEFL iBT 90 (or 4.5 on the new scale), IELTS 6.0 or Duolingo 120; exemptions for SAT EBRW 650+ or ACT Reading and English 27+.

name: King's College London
tests: No SAT/ACT; UCAT for medicine/dentistry and LNAT for law. English: KCL uses bands — most courses need IELTS 7.0 (6.5 in each part) or IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each); TOEFL iBT 92–100.

name: Seoul National University
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement; standardized results (SAT, ACT, AP, IB, A-level, IGCSE) may be submitted as supporting evidence. Language: Korean (TOPIK level 3+) or English (TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS Academic 6.0 or TEPS 269); TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS Online accepted. Most courses are taught in Korean. Art, music and PE applicants have practical exams/interviews.
gpa_note: Holistic document review of school performance, study plan and recommendations; admitted students are typically top of their class.

name: The University of Tokyo (UTokyo)
tests: Two routes, 100 places (50 each). Route A: Japan's Common Test for University Admissions (January 2027, about 80%+ expected) plus an English test, then in-person screening. Route B: an accepted standardized test or qualification (e.g. IB, A-level, SAT/ACT and others listed by UTokyo) plus a designated English proficiency test, then an online interview in English.

name: The University of Queensland (UQ)
tests: Minimum English for most programmes: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in every band (IELTS One Skill Retake accepted with the original test; IELTS Online not recognised); equivalent TOEFL/PTE scores per UQ's table; some programmes need more. Students below the level can take UQ English pathways.

name: University of Manchester
tests: No SAT/ACT; UCAT for medicine/dentistry. English: usually IELTS 6.5 overall with no component below 6.0 (7.0 for some courses).

name: Yonsei University
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement. UIC requires proof of English proficiency (TOEFL, IELTS, CEFR certificate, IB English A, AP English or English-medium schooling) with no minimum score. Selection is by document review plus an interview. Korean-taught Yonsei programmes require TOPIK instead.
gpa_note: Holistic document review (200 points) plus interview; strong academic records and English writing are expected.

name: Columbia University
tests: Test-optional for the 2026-27 cycle (fall 2027 entry); SAT/ACT required again from the 2027-28 cycle. English proficiency for non-native speakers: TOEFL 105, IELTS 7.5 or Duolingo 135 (older FAQ — verify).
strengths: Journalism & arts in New York City

name: Institut Polytechnique de Paris (École Polytechnique)
tests: No SAT/ACT required (scores can be reported if taken). English: TOEFL iBT 90 or IELTS 6.5 (min 6 per skill) or Cambridge C1/C2 176; results under two years old. No French required to apply (B2 French needed to graduate). Shortlisted candidates have a ~50-minute online interview.
gpa_note: Very strong overall academic average with advanced mathematics and at least one advanced science course; holistic review.

name: Northwestern University
tests: Test-optional: SAT/ACT not required (scores may be submitted). English proficiency score required if English is not your first language or school language (TOEFL iBT, IELTS incl. Indicator, Duolingo); no minimum, but competitive applicants score in the high range.
gpa_note: Most admitted students rank in the top 10% of their class with the most rigorous curriculum available.

name: University of British Columbia (UBC)
tests: SAT/ACT not required. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 (6.0 each), TOEFL iBT 90 (old scale; min 22 reading/listening, 21 speaking/writing) or Duolingo 125, unless exempt.

name: Zhejiang University
tests: SAT/ACT/IB/A-level or national exam results are submitted if applicable (not mandatory). From 2026/27 all international undergraduate applicants must submit a valid CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report. Chinese-taught programmes need an HSK certificate; English-taught programmes need TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent (no published minimum). Shortlisted applicants have a video interview.
gpa_note: Competitive selection on senior-high academic performance, language proficiency, CSCA results and interview.

name: Delft University of Technology (TU Delft)
tests: No SAT/ACT, but strong maths and physics at advanced school level are required, and numerus clausus programmes run a selection procedure (online tests/assignments). English: IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 90.

name: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)
tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT are not considered. English: IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115 or TOEFL iBT (80 on the old scale; UC lists 4.5 on the new 2026 scale) unless exempt.

name: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU)
tests: International qualifications (IB, A-level, SAT/AP, national diplomas) accepted; applicants from non-English-medium schools need an English test (see PolyU English requirements page).

name: University of Michigan – Ann Arbor
tests: Test-optional (SAT/ACT considered if submitted). English proficiency required for non-native speakers; typical minimums around TOEFL 100 (old scale), IELTS 7.0 or Duolingo 125 – check your school's page.

name: City University of Hong Kong (CityUHK)
tests: SAT/ACT may be used by applicants with US-curriculum qualifications; most international applicants are assessed on IB, A-level or national exam results. English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) is required for non-native speakers. Minimum scores could not be verified.
gpa_note: Competitive results in IB/A-level or equivalent are expected.

name: Korea University
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement (international results may be submitted as supporting evidence). Korean-taught programmes require TOPIK (usually level 3–4 or higher); English-taught tracks require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Exact minimums are set in each semester's admission guideline.
gpa_note: Holistic document review of school records and study plan; interviews for some programmes.

name: National Taiwan University (NTU)
tests: Requirements vary by department; most undergraduate programmes teach in Mandarin, so Chinese proficiency (TOCFL) is often required, while English-taught programmes require English proof. Check each department's requirements in the application guidelines.

name: Carnegie Mellon University
tests: SAT or ACT required. English for non-native speakers: TOEFL iBT 5+ on the new scale (section scores of 5+), IELTS Academic or Duolingo also accepted; historically CMU expected about IELTS 7.5 / TOEFL 102.

name: Universiti Malaya (UM)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is by your pre-university qualification (A-levels, IB, foundation, etc.). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent; minimum varies by programme). Official minimum scores could not be confirmed.
gpa_note: Strong pre-university results are expected; medicine, dentistry, law and pharmacy are most competitive.

name: University of Bristol
tests: No SAT/ACT; UCAT for medicine/dentistry. English: Bristol profiles range from IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each) to 7.5 (7.0 each) depending on course.

name: New York University (NYU)
tests: Test-optional (through at least the 2027-28 cycle). English test required if English is not your first language and you have not completed 3 years of English-only instruction; competitive scores are around TOEFL 100 (old scale), IELTS 7.5, Duolingo 125.

name: KU Leuven
tests: No SAT/ACT. Most bachelor's are taught in Dutch; English-taught bachelor's (a small number, e.g. in philosophy, theology and business/economics) require IELTS 6.5–7.0 or TOEFL iBT 79–94. Medicine/dentistry require the Flemish entrance exam.

name: University of Amsterdam (UvA)
tests: No SAT/ACT for most systems (US-system diplomas need SAT/ACT or AP). English-taught programmes: IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 92 typical; some require higher. Maths level may be required for economics/science.
